basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Portland, Oregon, I am a 34-year-old graphic designer who spends my free time immersed in the world of Monster Hunter, particularly wielding the Insect Glaive. I'm also a tech enthusiast who follows the latest trends in streaming technology, with a keen interest in Twitch startups. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings, catching up on my favorite subreddits. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore niche communities and unconventional topics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for over a decade. My expertise in technology is largely self-taught, driven by personal interest and a desire to stay ahead in the ever-evolving digital landscape. I regularly participate in online courses and forums to keep my skills sharp.
